description: Real CVEs in real projects, with the fix commit known. The hardest and most representative tier: these are flaws that shipped and were exploited, not flaws written to be found.

sources.name: vul4j
sources.notes: 79 reproducible Java CVEs across 51 projects and 25 CWEs, each with a proof-of-vulnerability test. The PoV is what makes the label checkable rather than asserted.

sources.name: cwe-bench-java
sources.notes: 120 manually vetted CVEs over path traversal, command injection, XSS and code injection. Ships machine-readable metadata, so ground truth can be derived rather than hand-transcribed.
